aiCreditRate.title: AI Credit Rate
aiCreditRate.subtitle: Set the price per AI credit, shown to tenants when they recharge.
aiCreditRate.rateHint: Tenants will see this rate applied to their plan's credit allowance when recharging.
aiCreditRate.tokenRateHint: Converts real OpenAI usage (AI chat and answer scoring) into credits spent from a tenant's balance. At least 1 credit is charged per AI call.

tenantOnboardingForm.sourceTenantHint: The chosen tenant's admin manages the actual form under Forms > Mappings.
